subject: error message when creating detection history

messages.author: 37ca2736ee34244e
messages.subject: error message when creating detection history
parts:
Hallo Jurgen and all,

I have been trying to build a detection matrix from camera trap data. The photo data is already in csv. So, here I use command:

DetHist1 <- detectionHistory(recordTable         = cat_bungo,
                             camOp                = matrix_bg,
                             stationCol           = "Station",
                             speciesCol           = "Species",
                             recordDateTimeCol    = "DateTime",
                             species              = "golden cat",
                             occasionLength       = 7,
                             day1                 = "Station",
                             datesAsOccasionNames = FALSE,
                             includeEffort        = FALSE,
                             timeZone             = "Asia/Bangkok"
                             )

here is the error message:

Error in detectionHistory(recordTable = cat_bungo, camOp = matrix_bg,  : 
  object 'date.test' not found

I have been looking at help page, but could not find any helpful note. Could you please assist me on this. For your details, here I am attaching subset of my data.

Best regards,
Iding

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: error message when creating detection history
parts:
Hi Iding,
this problem is easily fixed. It is the argument day 1 that causes the problem because it begins with a capital letter. Change it to "station" and it will work.

DetHist1 <- detectionHistory(recordTable         = cat_bungo,
                             camOp                = matrix_bg,
                             stationCol           = "Station",
                             speciesCol           = "Species",
                             recordDateTimeCol    = "DateTime",
                             species              = "golden cat",
                             occasionLength       = 7,
day1                 = "station",     # changed to lower case

datesAsOccasionNames = FALSE,
                             includeEffort        = FALSE,

timeZone             = "Asia/Bangkok",
                             recordDateTimeFormat = "%d-%m-%y %H:%M"
                             )

I'm sorry I did not think of this earlier. I will fix it in the next release. 
Thank you and best regards,
Jürgen

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: error message when creating detection history
parts:
Hi Iding,
i edited my answer above. It should now work. The problem is that Excel always strips the date/time column of the seconds and the default date/time format will not work anymore. You can either use the code above or restore the original date/time information by pasting the date and time columns with a space inbetween.
You will notice another error coming up:
Error: record date outside camera operation date range:  K042
This is because one of the records is in 2013 whereas the cameras were active in 2014, so this is a problem in the input data.
Hope it works now.
Best regards,
Jürgen
